purpose: Machine-readable audit driving the autonomous evolution mission (STAGE A). Evidence-based inventory of implemented vs reserved vs missing capabilities.

connectome.notes: 3 GraphModes with strict provenance separation; CSR v3 incoming-row convention; cache version-guarded + provenance persisted; graph_hash over topology+quantized weights; validate_invariants enforced.

brain_runtime.notes: LIF step (GPU/CPU), 8 sensorimotor index populations, activations EMA, prediction_error scalar + predicted_reward EMA, homeostatic drives, 3-factor Hebbian plasticity gated on |reward|>1e-4, motor readout argmax over 4 tool associations, snapshot/restore.

development.notes: neurogenesis/differentiate/migrate/grow_projections/prune/apoptosis all real graph mutations with CSR rebuild + hash recompute; deterministic per (seed,tick); consumes genome params neurogenesis_rate, differentiation_bias, migration_rate, synaptogenesis_rate, pruning_threshold, developmental_timing.

organism.notes: Closed loop: sense->brain->act->world->reward->plasticity(next tick); metabolism; structural development cycle every 5 ticks (neurogenesis costs energy); sleep replay; episodic+semantic memory; fitness vector; snapshot/restore incl. sensorimotor maps.

population.notes: Overlapping generations, sexual/asexual reproduction with deterministic crossover, eligible-parent filter, teaching by distance/stage; select_parents_pareto IMPLEMENTED BUT NOT CALLED (reserved).

culture.notes: teach() transfers skill value + provenance chain; Knowledge dataclass DEFINED BUT NEVER INSTANTIATED (reserved).

genome.notes: 15 params v1.0, bounds-checked, deterministic mutation/crossover with provenance. UNCONSUMED params: axon_growth_rate, dendrite_growth_rate, sociality, reproduction_threshold.

llm.notes: GGUF discovery with KV parsing; never fabricates text; 5 registered tools; request-level safety rejection; run_iteration with claim grounding.

events.notes: 28 VALID_EVENTS, hash-chained. NEVER EMITTED (reserved): DENDRITE_GROWN, SYNAPSE_STRENGTHENED, SYNAPSE_WEAKENED, MEMORY_RECALLED, GENERATION_ENDED, SNAPSHOT_SAVED.

memory.notes: SQLite episodic/semantic/skill/dream/experiment stores + RAM working memory. NOTE: Organism keeps its own episodes/semantic dicts and does NOT use PersistentMemoryManager.

world.notes: Toroidal grid, resources/hazards/regrow with tracked energy_injected, sense/apply_move/consume, world_hash, snapshot/restore.

gaps_blocking_mission: No LivingBrain versioned model: neuron/synapse identities are array indices (reused after apoptosis strips edges but ids grow monotonically); no per-neuron/per-synapse provenance classes (BIOLOGICAL/DERIVED/EMERGENT/EVOLVED/SYNTHETIC); no persistent structural event log tied to brain state.
No eligibility traces or composite neuromodulatory signal; plasticity driven by scalar reward only.
Prediction is a scalar EMA; does not influence attention, curiosity, memory priority, or exploration.
No autonomy engine: active_goal is a static string 'explore'; movement is run-and-tumble chemotaxis heuristic, not brain-state-driven compositional control.
No grounded language module; no symbol<->concept<->sensory grounding; no organism-produced symbol sequences.
No social model: no identity recognition, interaction history, trust, or relationship persistence between organisms.
No speciation evidence; no genome-distance divergence tracking.
No milestone detection or automatic scientific capture.
No LLM control plane with typed commands (SPAWN_POPULATION, START_RUN, ...) and research memory database.
No benchmark suite comparing LLM-only vs LLM+tools vs FlyBrain.
Genome cannot encode learning-architecture parameters (eligibility decay, neuromodulation weights, growth budget allocation).
Brain size CAN exceed biological seed (neurogenesis works) but expansions are not labeled with provenance classes and not tracked across generations.
Organism dead-neuron silence invariant block is an empty pass (line ~92).
teaching_sessions and EventLog are NOT persisted in Population.restore.
compatibility_risks: Genome.validate() pins version '1.0' — adding architecture params requires either same-version extension or a deliberate version bump with from_v1 migration.
Organism.snapshot/restore format is consumed by Population snapshot and campaign checkpoints — any new state must be additive with defaults to keep old checkpoints readable.
BrainRuntime plasticity mutates graph.weights in place — eligibility extension must keep this behavior in compatibility mode.
Acceptance matrix gate 30 (checkpoint_continuation) requires snapshot->restore->continue == uninterrupted; any new organism state must be fully included in snapshots.
EventLog.log raises on unknown types — new event types must be added to VALID_EVENTS atomically with emitters.
documentation_drift: README/final report previously used 'bit-exact' loosely for CPU/Vulkan parity; corrected in v2.0.0 to 'trajectory parity, spike-exact' — verification_contract.json now makes this normative.
README matrix table says 32/32 PASS on workstation but CI profile is 28 PASS / 4 SKIP — documented, but verification levels need a machine-readable source of truth.
performance_bottlenecks: cpu_lif_step is a Python loop over N neurons per step (fine for <=1k, bottleneck beyond ~10k).
Organism structural development cycle rebuilds CSR via Python dicts every 5 ticks.
Vulkan path does readback every step (correctness-first); no no-readback fast mode yet.
Population step is sequential per organism; no batching.
dangerous_assumptions: Organism brain state arrays are resized by _sync_brain_to_graph after growth — assumes indices beyond original N stay aligned with graph arrays; LivingBrain must formalize this.
organism_hash omits weights/refractory/activations — two organisms with identical potentials/spikes but different weights hash equal; acceptable for identity but must not be used as full-state proof.
World positions dict keyed by organism_id persists after death (harmless but leaks).
